why: What each way of making a cut can keep exact, and how much of the frame it leaves to a model (studio/maker.choose). A cut lists what must be right (shot list keeps, plus what its lines claim on screen); the method that keeps all of it and generates the most is chosen. The user, 2026-10-20: generative first, and no either/or of cut kinds - 'mechanism or world' was replaced by this. Values start from what the code guarantees; what is only plausible is marked unmeasured until a paid test with the user's cap measures it.

keeps_means.all: every pixel is Blender's: shape, motion, count and labels are exact
keeps_means.kept_parts: the named solid things are Blender pixels put back over the take (generative/keep.py): exact; the rest is the model's
keeps_means.shared_picture: the look is held by a start picture shared with the first cut that showed it (maker.look_anchor; Veo reads only the first frame): same look, not exact geometry
keeps_means.none: a model draws it: plausible, never exact

keepable_why: solid things the build places and the keep masks can cut out; a phenomenon (water, smoke, a spark) or a light has no outline to put back
focus_share_why: the frame area a cut's focus takes by its frame.size: the square of the focus height the reel flow measures by (wide under 0.5 of the height, close past 0.66, filled at 0.95 - reel_flow WIDE_HEIGHT_MAX, CLOSE_HEIGHT, FILL_HEIGHT), at the middle of each band; the build's probe measures the real share later
generate_min_why: a model repainting less than a quarter of the frame does not carry the cut's look: it only frames Blender pixels, and the paid pass buys little - then Blender alone. A starting value, to be measured with the hybrid check

methods.why: Veo 3.1 image to video from the cut's start picture: places, people, results and moods; it reads only the first frame, so nothing in it is exact (routing.py)
methods.quality: measured 2026-10-16: motion plausible, foot and ground plausibly wrong - a person reviews every take (video-review)

methods.why: a Blender pass restyled by a video model, the parts that must be right put back from Blender pixels (generative/keep.py auto_keep)
methods.quality: unmeasured: kept parts are exact by construction; whether the restyled rest looks right is not yet measured (whole-frame restyles failed 2026-10-04 A/B 6/6 and G8 2/2)

methods.why: Blender pixels everywhere except the regions screen.generate_only names (wan-vace-inpaint)
methods.quality: unmeasured: wired and tested in code, never run on a reel - off until a paid test

methods.why: every pixel built and rendered: exact, and the look is the look preset's
methods.quality: measured: the build and its checks
